messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Government Relations, ESG and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear The Executive Network Team,

Your Riyadh-based work on Board and Executive-level search, including leadership mandates across major Saudi projects and the public sector, makes this a strong fit for my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Director or Representative, Government Relations, External or Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across industrial, infrastructure, energy, mining, sovereign-linked and other complex organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
